data.name: Pitamber
data.gender_notes: Pitamber is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pitamber is derived from two Sanskrit words - Pita (Father) and Ambar (Sky or Treasure). This name is believed to represent the God who holds the treasures of the universe in his arms. It is a revered name among Hindus and is often given to boys as a mark of respect and devotion. The name Pitamber carries the meaning “Lord of Treasures” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pitamber usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of treasures and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wealth, knowledge, and power. It is believed that those named Pitamber are blessed with abundance and wisdom.
data.etymology: Pitamber belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Treasures.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pitamber total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pitamber is deeply rooted in the Hindu culture and carries immense reverence. The first syllable 'Pita' signifies respect and devotion towards one's father or elders. The second syllable 'Ambar' signifies the vast expanse of the universe and the infinite treasures it holds. The name Pitamber is therefore an embodiment of the idea of respecting and acknowledging the wisdom and bounties of the universe and one's elders.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pitamber carries profound spiritual significance as it is believed to represent the divine essence of the universal father, who protects and nourishes all beings. The name is also a reminder of the importance of gratitude, reverence, and respect towards the divine and the elders in one's life. By invoking the name Pitamber, one seeks blessings, protection, and guidance from the divine force that permeates the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pitamber: The radiant embodiment of Lord Vishnu, bestowing wisdom and protection. His name signifies the inner light of knowledge and the external shelter in times of need.
